name: Software & Product Engineering

offerings.name: Software Health Check
offerings.definition: A bounded diagnostic engagement that reviews an application's technical condition and translates findings into business risks and a prioritized improvement roadmap. It establishes where deeper investigation or corrective delivery should begin.
offerings.scope: Review architecture, code samples, dependencies, deployment practices and operational evidence.
offerings.deliverables: Health report; risk register; prioritized roadmap; leadership readout.
offerings.value: Supports informed investment and reduces uncertainty about inherited software.

offerings.name: Software Risk & Health Assessment
offerings.definition: A structured assessment of software weaknesses that could affect reliability, security, maintainability or continued business operation. Findings are assessed against the application's criticality rather than treated as an undifferentiated technical issue list.
offerings.scope: Assess technical risks, supportability, dependency health and business impact.
offerings.deliverables: Evidence-based findings; risk ratings; recommended treatments and owners.
offerings.value: Helps leaders address the most consequential weaknesses first.

offerings.name: Technology Due Diligence
offerings.definition: An independent technical examination of a software asset in an investment, acquisition or partnership decision. It evaluates the credibility of the technology, delivery capability and likely remediation obligations within an agreed evidence boundary.
offerings.scope: Inspect architecture, code quality, ownership evidence, operations and engineering practices.
offerings.deliverables: Technical diligence report; key concerns; remediation estimates and open questions.
offerings.value: Makes technology-related deal assumptions more transparent.

offerings.name: Architecture Strategy & Roadmap
offerings.definition: A planning service that defines the desired future structure of applications, data and integrations, then sequences the changes needed to reach it. Trade-offs are recorded against business priorities and constraints.
offerings.scope: Assess current state; compare design options; define target state and migration stages.
offerings.deliverables: Architecture blueprint; decision records; dependency map; phased roadmap.
offerings.value: Aligns technology investment with business growth and operational needs.

offerings.name: Architecture Review
offerings.definition: A focused evaluation of an existing or proposed technical design against agreed quality goals such as availability, performance, security and maintainability. It identifies design risks and practical corrections before or during delivery.
offerings.scope: Review components, interfaces, data flows, failure modes and deployment assumptions.
offerings.deliverables: Review findings; design recommendations; prioritized architectural risks.
offerings.value: Reduces avoidable redesign and highlights critical design assumptions.

offerings.name: MVP Launch Package
offerings.definition: A starting engagement that takes one validated business workflow from definition to a usable minimum viable product. It combines essential discovery, design, build and release work while deliberately limiting features to those needed for early learning.
offerings.scope: Define the first workflow; prototype; build essential functions; test and release.
offerings.deliverables: Working first release; acceptance evidence; handover; evolution backlog.
offerings.value: Enables earlier customer feedback and tests product assumptions.

offerings.name: Product Discovery & Validation
offerings.definition: A discovery service that tests whether a proposed product solves a meaningful user problem and identifies the smallest useful scope. It connects user research, commercial assumptions and technical feasibility before substantial development investment.
offerings.scope: Interview stakeholders and users; map journeys; test hypotheses; prioritize needs.
offerings.deliverables: Validated problem statement; user journeys; prioritized backlog; feasibility findings.
offerings.value: Reduces investment in features customers may not need.

offerings.name: UX Design & Prototyping
offerings.definition: A design service that turns user needs into understandable interaction flows and testable prototypes. It explores how people complete tasks, including errors and accessibility needs, before committing the experience to production code.
offerings.scope: Map tasks; design screens and states; prototype interactions; conduct usability reviews.
offerings.deliverables: Wireframes; interactive prototype; design specifications; usability findings.
offerings.value: Improves task clarity and reduces expensive late design changes.

offerings.name: MVP Development
offerings.definition: Development of a deliberately limited product release that delivers a usable core workflow and supports real user feedback. The scope balances speed of learning with essential quality, security and operational requirements.
offerings.scope: Implement agreed backlog; integrate required systems; test core journeys; prepare release.
offerings.deliverables: Deployable minimum viable product; source code; tests; release documentation.
offerings.value: Tests demand through a functioning product rather than assumptions alone.

offerings.name: Web & Mobile App Development
offerings.definition: Design and development of applications for agreed browser and mobile channels. The service covers the selected user journeys, backend connections and release requirements, with platform choices driven by audience, device needs and operating constraints.
offerings.scope: Build interfaces and APIs; integrate services; test devices and journeys; prepare releases.
offerings.deliverables: Application increment; source code; test results; deployment and support handover.
offerings.value: Gives customers or employees dependable digital access to business services.

offerings.name: SaaS Platform Development
offerings.definition: Development of the shared platform capabilities needed to deliver software as a subscription service. It addresses tenant separation, onboarding and configurable access so multiple customer organizations can use the product under defined operating rules.
offerings.scope: Design tenancy; implement onboarding, entitlements, configuration and usage controls.
offerings.deliverables: Platform components; tenant isolation tests; operating guidance; onboarding workflow.
offerings.value: Supports repeatable customer onboarding and scalable product operations.

offerings.name: Product Enhancement & Evolution
offerings.definition: Incremental improvement of an existing product through new features, usability changes or targeted technical enhancements. Work is prioritized around customer and business outcomes while protecting established functionality through regression testing and controlled releases.
offerings.scope: Refine feature backlog; implement changes; test compatibility; release and document.
offerings.deliverables: Tested feature increment; updated documentation; release notes; handover.
offerings.value: Keeps the product useful as customer and market needs change.

offerings.name: Modernization Discovery & Pilot
offerings.definition: A starting engagement that combines legacy-system discovery with a limited modernization experiment. The pilot tests whether the proposed approach can preserve essential behavior and reduce risk before a wider migration or replacement is approved.
offerings.scope: Map dependencies; compare options; implement a bounded pilot; evaluate results.
offerings.deliverables: Modernization assessment; pilot evidence; recommended migration roadmap.
offerings.value: Replaces speculative transformation plans with evidence from a practical trial.

offerings.name: Technical Debt Assessment & Action Plan
offerings.definition: An assessment of accumulated technical shortcuts, obsolete components and structural weaknesses that make software costly or risky to change. It converts those issues into a ranked action plan based on business impact and remediation effort.
offerings.scope: Identify debt; assess change friction; estimate effort; prioritize treatment.
offerings.deliverables: Technical debt register; impact assessment; sequenced remediation backlog.
offerings.value: Directs engineering effort toward debt that materially affects delivery or operations.

offerings.name: Legacy Application Review & Roadmap
offerings.definition: An evaluation of an older application to determine whether to retain, upgrade, restructure, replace or retire its capabilities. The roadmap considers business dependence, technology support, integration complexity and the practicality of phased change.
offerings.scope: Inventory functions and dependencies; assess support risks; compare modernization paths.
offerings.deliverables: Legacy assessment; option comparison; dependency map; transition roadmap.
offerings.value: Clarifies a sustainable path for business-critical legacy software.

offerings.name: Framework & Runtime Upgrades
offerings.definition: A controlled upgrade of application frameworks, language runtimes or supporting libraries to a selected supported version. Compatibility work and regression testing address behavioral changes, removed features and dependencies affected by the upgrade.
offerings.scope: Review compatibility; update dependencies; adapt code; test and plan rollback.
offerings.deliverables: Upgraded application; compatibility findings; regression evidence; rollback plan.
offerings.value: Reduces exposure to unsupported components and enables future maintenance.

offerings.name: Application Architecture Renewal
offerings.definition: A bounded redesign of an application's internal structure to improve qualities such as modularity, maintainability or scalability while preserving agreed business behavior. It changes how the system is organized rather than replacing every function.
offerings.scope: Define target boundaries; refactor selected components; test interfaces and behavior.
offerings.deliverables: Reworked components; design records; regression evidence; migration notes.
offerings.value: Makes future changes easier and isolates operational or scaling bottlenecks.

offerings.name: Database Modernization
offerings.definition: Improvement or migration of the database layer to better support current reliability, performance, maintainability or platform requirements. The work includes validation of data integrity and application behavior across the proposed change.
offerings.scope: Assess schema and workload; select target changes; migrate or tune; reconcile data.
offerings.deliverables: Updated database design or platform; migration scripts; validation and rollback evidence.
offerings.value: Improves the sustainability and fitness of a critical data foundation.

offerings.name: Phased Application Re-engineering
offerings.definition: Progressive replacement or rebuilding of selected application capabilities while the wider business system continues operating. The engagement uses defined transition boundaries, coexistence arrangements and rollback plans to manage disruption.
offerings.scope: Choose replacement slice; rebuild functions; bridge dependencies; stage cutover.
offerings.deliverables: Replacement capability; coexistence interfaces; migration tests; cutover plan.
offerings.value: Spreads transformation risk across manageable releases.

offerings.name: Business Integration Launch Package
offerings.definition: A starting integration engagement that connects two named systems for one business-critical workflow. It establishes data ownership, mappings and failure handling so information moves dependably and exceptions have a clear operational owner.
offerings.scope: Map workflow and records; build connector; test errors; establish monitoring.
offerings.deliverables: Working integration; mapping specification; exception process; operating handover.
offerings.value: Reduces repeated manual entry and improves consistency between systems.

offerings.name: API Design & Development
offerings.definition: Design and implementation of application programming interfaces that expose business functions or data through explicit, documented contracts. The service addresses request validation, access, errors and compatibility so consumers can integrate predictably.
offerings.scope: Define contracts; implement endpoints; add authorization and validation; test consumers.
offerings.deliverables: API specification; implemented endpoints; automated tests; usage documentation.
offerings.value: Enables reliable reuse of business capabilities across applications.

offerings.name: API Gateway Setup & Configuration
offerings.definition: Configuration of a gateway that manages how requests reach selected APIs. It applies agreed traffic, access and routing controls at a common entry point while leaving application-specific business logic within the underlying services.
offerings.scope: Configure routes, authentication integration, quotas, traffic policies and telemetry.
offerings.deliverables: Gateway configuration; policy documentation; traffic tests; operating guide.
offerings.value: Improves consistency and visibility in API access management.

offerings.name: Business System Integration
offerings.definition: Implementation of a business workflow spanning multiple applications, with explicit ownership of each data object and transaction state. It includes mapping, synchronization and exception handling rather than treating integration as simple data transfer.
offerings.scope: Specify interfaces; map data; implement synchronization; handle retries and reconciliation.
offerings.deliverables: Integration components; interface contracts; test evidence; support runbook.
offerings.value: Reduces process fragmentation and inconsistent records.

offerings.name: Event-driven Workflow Development
offerings.definition: Development of workflows that react to business events instead of relying only on direct synchronous requests. The service defines event meaning and handles duplicate delivery, ordering assumptions and recovery for agreed business scenarios.
offerings.scope: Design event contracts; implement producers and consumers; test replay and failures.
offerings.deliverables: Event schemas; messaging components; recovery procedures; integration tests.
offerings.value: Decouples systems and supports responsive business processes.

offerings.name: Partner & Third-party Integration
offerings.definition: Connection of an internal system to a partner or external provider using its agreed interface. The work covers authentication, data transformation, environment differences and external failure handling so the relationship can operate consistently.
offerings.scope: Review provider contract; implement adapter; test edge cases; document onboarding.
offerings.deliverables: Tested connector; mapping rules; error handling; partner onboarding guide.
offerings.value: Shortens partner onboarding and reduces manual coordination.

offerings.name: Integration Diagnostics & Repair
offerings.definition: Investigation and correction of a malfunctioning integration within a defined boundary. It traces failures across data, authentication, mappings and message handling, then validates the repair against realistic transactions and recovery scenarios.
offerings.scope: Analyze logs and failed records; reproduce issues; repair; retest and reconcile.
offerings.deliverables: Root-cause findings; corrected connector or configuration; test evidence; recovery instructions.
offerings.value: Restores dependable transaction flow and reduces recurring exceptions.

offerings.name: Identity Platform Starter Package
offerings.definition: A starting identity engagement that selects an appropriate identity platform and establishes a working foundation for one application. It combines requirements-based choice with initial configuration and validation of the essential sign-in and access flows.
offerings.scope: Assess identity needs; compare platforms; configure tenant; connect one application.
offerings.deliverables: Selection rationale; configured foundation; sign-in tests; operating handover.
offerings.value: Creates a practical basis for consistent application identity management.

offerings.name: Identity Platform Advisory & Selection
offerings.definition: An advisory service that compares identity platforms against the organization's user populations, integration needs, security requirements and operational constraints. The recommendation explains trade-offs rather than assuming one provider suits every situation.
offerings.scope: Gather requirements; evaluate federation, lifecycle, hosting and commercial fit.
offerings.deliverables: Requirements matrix; platform comparison; recommendation; adoption roadmap.
offerings.value: Reduces mismatch between identity technology and business requirements.

offerings.name: Identity Platform Setup & Configuration
offerings.definition: Implementation of an agreed identity provider and its foundational configuration. It establishes the selected authentication flows, administrative roles and operational settings required to support applications under a defined identity model.
offerings.scope: Configure tenant, directories, applications, sign-in policies and administrator access.
offerings.deliverables: Configured identity platform; access tests; configuration record; operating guide.
offerings.value: Provides a maintainable foundation for application access.

offerings.name: Single Sign-on & Identity Federation
offerings.definition: Integration that lets users authenticate through trusted identity providers and access agreed applications without separate credentials for every system. Federation establishes trust across identity domains; application authorization still requires its own access rules.
offerings.scope: Configure trust and claims; integrate applications; test sign-in, logout and failure cases.
offerings.deliverables: Federation configuration; application integration; claims mapping; test results.
offerings.value: Simplifies user access and centralizes authentication management.

offerings.name: Roles, Permissions & Access Controls
offerings.definition: Design and implementation of authorization rules that determine what authenticated users or services may do. It translates business responsibilities into roles, resource permissions and enforceable policies, including tests for prohibited actions.
offerings.scope: Map responsibilities; design roles and permissions; implement enforcement; test access boundaries.
offerings.deliverables: Role matrix; access policies; enforcement changes; authorization tests.
offerings.value: Reduces excessive access and makes responsibilities clearer.

offerings.name: Identity Platform Migration
offerings.definition: A controlled transition from one identity system or authentication arrangement to another. It preserves essential user access while addressing account matching, claim differences, application dependencies and staged cutover requirements.
offerings.scope: Map identities and claims; plan account transition; update integrations; rehearse cutover.
offerings.deliverables: Migration design; mapping rules; tested integrations; cutover and rollback plan.
offerings.value: Reduces disruption during identity-platform change.

offerings.name: User Provisioning & Access Lifecycle
offerings.definition: Automation and control of account creation, access changes and removal as people join, move within or leave an organization. The service connects authoritative identity events to application access and verifies timely deprovisioning.
offerings.scope: Map lifecycle events; implement provisioning; configure approvals and reconciliation.
offerings.deliverables: Lifecycle workflows; connector configuration; exception process; access-removal tests.
offerings.value: Reduces manual administration and stale access.

offerings.name: Release Readiness Accelerator
offerings.definition: A focused engagement that makes one application's release process repeatable and its quality checks visible. It combines prioritized testing and release improvements with evidence that a selected change can be deployed and recovered safely.
offerings.scope: Assess release gaps; implement key checks; rehearse deployment and rollback.
offerings.deliverables: Improved release workflow; quality gates; release evidence; handover checklist.
offerings.value: Builds confidence in shipping a defined application change.

offerings.name: Quality Assessment & Test Strategy
offerings.definition: An assessment of how software quality is managed and a plan for testing the risks that matter most. It defines appropriate test levels, data, environments and ownership rather than recommending automation for every possible check.
offerings.scope: Review defects and coverage; prioritize risks; define test approach and responsibilities.
offerings.deliverables: Quality assessment; test strategy; coverage priorities; implementation backlog.
offerings.value: Focuses quality investment on business-critical failure modes.

offerings.name: Automated Testing
offerings.definition: Creation of repeatable software checks that verify selected behaviors automatically. The work selects suitable test levels and stable data so failures provide useful feedback, while keeping maintenance responsibilities explicit.
offerings.scope: Implement unit, API or journey tests; manage test data; integrate execution.
offerings.deliverables: Automated test suite; execution reports; maintenance guidance; pipeline integration.
offerings.value: Shortens feedback cycles and reduces repetitive regression effort.

offerings.name: Continuous Reliability Improvement
offerings.definition: An ongoing improvement discipline that uses incidents, service signals and recurring operational work to prioritize preventive changes. It converts reliability concerns into an owned backlog with measurable evidence of progress.
offerings.scope: Review service history; rank risks; implement preventive changes; review outcomes.
offerings.deliverables: Reliability backlog; tested improvements; operating updates; periodic progress review.
offerings.value: Reduces repeat incidents and improves operational predictability.

offerings.name: Performance & Resilience Testing
offerings.definition: Controlled testing of how an application behaves under expected load, peak demand and selected failures. It measures capacity limits and recovery behavior against agreed criteria without assuming that passing one test guarantees all production conditions.
offerings.scope: Design workload and failure scenarios; execute tests; analyze bottlenecks and recovery.
offerings.deliverables: Performance results; resilience findings; capacity guidance; remediation recommendations.
offerings.value: Exposes scaling and recovery weaknesses before critical demand.

offerings.name: Managed Application & Platform Support
offerings.definition: A contracted service for operating and maintaining named applications and platforms after release. Responsibilities, service hours, escalation paths and change boundaries are agreed so incidents and routine work have clear ownership.
offerings.scope: Monitor agreed services; triage issues; perform maintenance; manage escalation and improvements.
offerings.deliverables: Support plan; ticket and service reports; maintenance records; improvement backlog.
offerings.value: Provides operational continuity and a clear route for resolving issues.

tagline: Build, modernize and improve your software.

offerings.name: DevOps Health Check
offerings.definition: A diagnostic review of the practices and systems used to build, release and operate software. It identifies delivery friction and operational risk, then prioritizes practical improvements across tools, workflows and ownership.
offerings.scope: Review delivery flow, automation, environments and operational practices.
offerings.deliverables: Health assessment; constraint map; prioritized improvement roadmap.
offerings.value: Clarifies where DevOps investment can remove the greatest friction.

offerings.name: Delivery Bottleneck Review
offerings.definition: An examination of the end-to-end change process to locate delays, rework and handoff problems. It uses actual delivery evidence to distinguish tooling issues from process and organizational constraints.
offerings.scope: Map change flow; measure waiting and rework; analyze handoffs.
offerings.deliverables: Value-stream map; bottleneck findings; improvement recommendations.
offerings.value: Targets the constraints that slow business change.

offerings.name: DevOps Toolchain Strategy & Roadmap
offerings.definition: A requirements-led plan for the tools and integrations supporting engineering delivery. It evaluates how the toolchain should work together, including adoption, ownership and migration from existing arrangements.
offerings.scope: Inventory tools; assess gaps and overlaps; compare options; sequence adoption.
offerings.deliverables: Toolchain architecture; selection criteria; integration and adoption roadmap.
offerings.value: Reduces fragmented tooling and unnecessary operating complexity.

offerings.name: DevOps Operating Model Design
offerings.definition: Design of the responsibilities and working arrangements through which teams deliver and operate technology. It clarifies service boundaries, decision rights and interactions between product, engineering, platform and operations teams.
offerings.scope: Define team services, ownership, escalation, change responsibilities and collaboration routines.
offerings.deliverables: Operating model; responsibility matrix; service boundaries; adoption plan.
offerings.value: Reduces ambiguous ownership and cross-team handoff delays.

offerings.name: Engineering & Delivery Maturity Review
offerings.definition: An evidence-based assessment of engineering and delivery practices against a defined maturity model. It evaluates capabilities and constraints to prioritize improvement, rather than using maturity scores as a substitute for business outcomes.
offerings.scope: Review development, testing, release and operating practices; validate findings.
offerings.deliverables: Capability assessment; supporting evidence; prioritized improvement plan.
offerings.value: Creates a shared baseline for engineering improvement.

offerings.name: Infrastructure Automation Pilot
offerings.definition: A limited implementation that proves infrastructure can be created and changed through a repeatable, reviewed process. One environment provides evidence and reusable patterns before automation is extended across the estate.
offerings.scope: Select environment; write infrastructure definitions; test provisioning and controlled changes.
offerings.deliverables: Versioned infrastructure; pilot environment; validation results; adoption recommendations.
offerings.value: Tests automation benefits before a broader rollout.

offerings.name: Cloud Foundation Setup
offerings.definition: Configuration of the foundational cloud structure needed to host agreed workloads. It establishes accounts or projects, networks, identity, logging and basic operational controls without assuming that every application is included.
offerings.scope: Configure resource hierarchy, networking, access, logging and operating baselines.
offerings.deliverables: Cloud foundation; configuration records; access tests; operating guide.
offerings.value: Gives workload teams a consistent and controlled starting environment.

offerings.name: Infrastructure as Code
offerings.definition: Management of infrastructure through machine-readable, version-controlled definitions rather than undocumented manual configuration. Changes are reviewed and applied through repeatable workflows with explicit state and access handling.
offerings.scope: Develop infrastructure modules; establish review, plan and apply workflows; test changes.
offerings.deliverables: Reusable definitions; deployment workflow; state-management approach; documentation.
offerings.value: Improves repeatability and traceability of infrastructure changes.

offerings.name: Automated Environment Provisioning
offerings.definition: Automation that creates usable development, test or production environments from agreed templates. It coordinates infrastructure and configuration so teams can obtain consistent environments with fewer manual dependencies.
offerings.scope: Define environment templates; automate setup; apply access and configuration; validate readiness.
offerings.deliverables: Provisioning workflow; templates; readiness tests; operating instructions.
offerings.value: Reduces environment setup delays and inconsistency.

offerings.name: Configuration & Drift Control
offerings.definition: Establishment of approved configuration baselines and detection of differences between intended and actual state. The service defines which changes can be corrected automatically and which require review or an exception.
offerings.scope: Define baselines; detect deviations; configure remediation and exception handling.
offerings.deliverables: Baseline definitions; drift reports; remediation workflow; ownership rules.
offerings.value: Reduces unnoticed configuration changes and inconsistent environments.

offerings.name: Backup & Recovery Implementation
offerings.definition: Implementation of backup and restoration procedures for agreed workloads and data. The service validates that selected backups can be restored, with recovery objectives and operating responsibilities explicitly defined.
offerings.scope: Configure backup policies; manage retention and access; test restoration.
offerings.deliverables: Backup configuration; restore evidence; recovery runbook; responsibility matrix.
offerings.value: Improves confidence that essential data and services can be recovered.

offerings.name: Application & Workload Cloud Migration
offerings.definition: Planning and execution of a defined workload move to a cloud environment. It addresses application dependencies, data transfer and operational readiness, with migration waves and rollback decisions based on tested behavior.
offerings.scope: Assess dependencies; prepare target; migrate and validate; execute controlled cutover.
offerings.deliverables: Migration plan; migrated workload; validation results; cutover and rollback guidance.
offerings.value: Enables platform change while managing business disruption.

offerings.name: Developer Platform Starter Package
offerings.definition: A starting engagement that establishes a supported path for one application team to build and deploy on a shared platform. It combines a working pattern with the documentation and ownership needed for repeatable use.
offerings.scope: Select application; establish platform workflow; validate deployment and developer experience.
offerings.deliverables: Working deployment path; reusable template; operating guide; team handover.
offerings.value: Reduces repeated setup work and tests platform adoption assumptions.

offerings.name: Application Containerization
offerings.definition: Packaging an application and its runtime dependencies into container images with defined configuration and execution behavior. It includes the adjustments needed for repeatable builds and operation in the selected environment.
offerings.scope: Create image builds; externalize configuration; assess storage and networking; test runtime.
offerings.deliverables: Container definitions; images; runtime configuration; validation results.
offerings.value: Improves deployment consistency across environments.

offerings.name: Container Platform Setup
offerings.definition: Implementation of a platform for deploying and operating containerized workloads. The scope defines cluster services, workload access, deployment patterns and operational responsibilities for the selected hosting arrangement.
offerings.scope: Configure orchestration, access, networking, storage and workload deployment.
offerings.deliverables: Platform baseline; workload templates; operating procedures; acceptance tests.
offerings.value: Creates a managed foundation for running containerized applications.

offerings.name: Platform Upgrades & Lifecycle Management
offerings.definition: Controlled maintenance of platform components through upgrades and lifecycle changes. Compatibility testing, dependency review and rollback preparation help keep the platform supportable without treating each update as an isolated change.
offerings.scope: Review support status; test upgrades; plan maintenance; validate workloads.
offerings.deliverables: Upgrade plan; updated components; compatibility evidence; rollback instructions.
offerings.value: Reduces obsolescence and disruption from unmanaged platform changes.

offerings.name: GitOps Deployment Automation
offerings.definition: A deployment approach that uses version-controlled desired state and automated reconciliation to manage environments. Changes are reviewed in the repository, while the deployment system detects and applies the approved state.
offerings.scope: Define desired-state repositories; configure reconciliation; implement access and promotion controls.
offerings.deliverables: Deployment repositories; reconciliation configuration; change workflow; recovery guide.
offerings.value: Improves deployment traceability and consistency.

offerings.name: Developer Self-service Workflows
offerings.definition: Creation of supported workflows through which developers perform approved platform tasks without repeated manual tickets. Templates and guardrails make routine work easier while preserving required review and ownership.
offerings.scope: Identify repetitive tasks; build templates or portals; define controls; test usability.
offerings.deliverables: Self-service workflow; reusable templates; usage documentation; support model.
offerings.value: Reduces platform-team bottlenecks for routine developer needs.

offerings.name: Release Pipeline Starter Package
offerings.definition: A starting engagement that builds a repeatable delivery pipeline for one application. It connects source changes, builds, checks and deployment into a visible workflow with agreed release controls and recovery behavior.
offerings.scope: Configure build, tests, artifacts and deployment; validate a release and rollback.
offerings.deliverables: Working pipeline; release evidence; configuration; team handover.
offerings.value: Makes application releases more predictable and repeatable.

offerings.name: Pipeline Diagnostics & Repair
offerings.definition: Diagnosis and repair of a pipeline that fails, produces inconsistent outputs or requires excessive manual intervention. Work focuses on reproducible causes and validates the corrected behavior across representative changes.
offerings.scope: Inspect runs and dependencies; reproduce failures; repair stages; retest.
offerings.deliverables: Root-cause report; corrected pipeline; validation evidence; maintenance guidance.
offerings.value: Restores dependable engineering feedback and release flow.

offerings.name: Automated Builds & Continuous Integration
offerings.definition: Automation that compiles or packages source changes and runs early checks whenever developers integrate work. Consistent build inputs and versioned outputs help identify regressions before changes reach later release stages.
offerings.scope: Configure build triggers, automated checks, dependency handling and artifact creation.
offerings.deliverables: Continuous integration workflow; versioned artifacts; check results; operating notes.
offerings.value: Finds integration problems earlier and reduces manual build effort.

offerings.name: Deployment Automation & Continuous Delivery
offerings.definition: Automation that moves tested software through agreed environments and keeps it ready for controlled release. Continuous delivery allows release on demand; it does not require every change to be deployed automatically to production.
offerings.scope: Automate environment promotion; implement approvals, deployment checks and rollback.
offerings.deliverables: Delivery workflow; deployment scripts; release records; rollback procedures.
offerings.value: Reduces manual deployment errors and release coordination effort.

offerings.name: Release & Branching Strategy
offerings.definition: Definition of source-control and release conventions that fit the team's product, deployment and support needs. It clarifies how changes are integrated, versioned, released and corrected without imposing unnecessary branch complexity.
offerings.scope: Assess release cadence; define branches, versions, hotfixes and integration rules.
offerings.deliverables: Branching policy; release conventions; worked examples; adoption guidance.
offerings.value: Reduces integration confusion and inconsistent release practices.

offerings.name: Artifact & Dependency Management
offerings.definition: Management of the packages and dependencies used and produced by software delivery. It establishes trusted repositories, versioning, retention and access rules so builds can use traceable inputs and recoverable outputs.
offerings.scope: Configure repositories; govern dependencies; define retention and access; validate retrieval.
offerings.deliverables: Repository setup; dependency policies; artifact lifecycle rules; documentation.
offerings.value: Improves build reproducibility and control of software components.

offerings.name: Progressive Rollouts & Rollback
offerings.definition: Implementation of staged deployment techniques that expose changes gradually and provide an explicit recovery path. Traffic shifts or release cohorts are evaluated against defined health criteria before wider rollout.
offerings.scope: Select rollout pattern; configure health checks; test rollback and data compatibility.
offerings.deliverables: Rollout workflow; decision thresholds; rollback procedure; test evidence.
offerings.value: Limits the impact of a problematic release.

offerings.name: Secure Delivery Starter Package
offerings.definition: A starting engagement that integrates agreed security checks into one application's delivery workflow. It establishes usable findings, exception handling and evidence so security becomes part of the release process.
offerings.scope: Choose relevant checks; integrate tooling; define failure and exception rules.
offerings.deliverables: Secured pipeline configuration; findings workflow; control evidence; handover.
offerings.value: Introduces repeatable security checks without an undefined transformation scope.

offerings.name: Delivery Security Assessment
offerings.definition: Assessment of security risks across source repositories, build systems, dependencies, artifacts and deployment access. It examines how a change could be tampered with or gain excessive privileges during delivery.
offerings.scope: Review identities, secrets, dependencies, build trust and deployment permissions.
offerings.deliverables: Delivery risk assessment; prioritized findings; corrective roadmap.
offerings.value: Identifies weaknesses beyond the application code itself.

offerings.name: Pipeline Security & Automated Checks
offerings.definition: Integration of automated security checks into build and release workflows. Findings are routed through agreed severity, review and exception rules so checks support actionable decisions rather than merely generate reports.
offerings.scope: Configure relevant scanners; tune rules; integrate gates; define triage ownership.
offerings.deliverables: Pipeline checks; severity and exception policy; findings reports; operating guide.
offerings.value: Finds selected security issues earlier in delivery.

offerings.name: Secrets & Service Identity Management
offerings.definition: Control of credentials and non-human identities used by applications and automation. It establishes how secrets are stored, accessed, rotated and removed, with permissions restricted to the required workload actions.
offerings.scope: Inventory credentials; configure storage and access; automate lifecycle; test revocation.
offerings.deliverables: Secret-management configuration; identity permissions; rotation procedures; audit records.
offerings.value: Reduces unnecessary credential exposure and long-lived access.

offerings.name: Software Supply Chain Security Controls
offerings.definition: Controls that improve confidence in the origin and integrity of software components and build outputs. The service addresses dependency visibility, build provenance and verification within a clearly defined delivery boundary.
offerings.scope: Inventory components; establish provenance; protect build outputs; verify artifacts.
offerings.deliverables: Component inventory; provenance records; verification controls; implementation guide.
offerings.value: Makes software inputs and outputs more traceable.

offerings.name: Policy as Code & Automated Guardrails
offerings.definition: Implementation of machine-readable rules that check or constrain infrastructure and deployment changes. Guardrails enforce agreed requirements consistently, while an explicit exception process handles legitimate deviations.
offerings.scope: Translate policies into rules; integrate enforcement; test allowed and denied cases.
offerings.deliverables: Policy code; test cases; enforcement configuration; exception workflow.
offerings.value: Reduces inconsistent manual policy checks.

offerings.name: Control Evidence & Reporting Automation
offerings.definition: Automation that collects and organizes technical records needed to demonstrate selected delivery controls. It maps evidence to client-defined requirements without implying that automated collection alone establishes compliance.
offerings.scope: Map controls to records; collect evidence; track exceptions; create reporting views.
offerings.deliverables: Evidence collection workflow; control mapping; traceable reports; ownership guide.
offerings.value: Reduces repeated manual evidence gathering.

offerings.name: Service Reliability Starter Package
offerings.definition: A starting reliability engagement focused on one important user journey. It establishes meaningful service signals, useful alerts and a response path that can be tested before extending coverage to other services.
offerings.scope: Select critical journey; instrument signals; configure alerts; rehearse response.
offerings.deliverables: Service dashboard; alert rules; response runbook; readiness findings.
offerings.value: Connects monitoring to a concrete customer experience.

offerings.name: Observability Health Check
offerings.definition: An assessment of whether existing telemetry helps teams understand service behavior and diagnose problems. It evaluates coverage, signal quality and operational usefulness rather than simply counting dashboards or collected logs.
offerings.scope: Review logs, metrics, traces, dashboards and alert practices.
offerings.deliverables: Telemetry gap analysis; instrumentation plan; signal-quality recommendations.
offerings.value: Improves the usefulness of existing monitoring investment.

offerings.name: Service Reliability Targets & Alerting
offerings.definition: Definition of measurable service reliability objectives and alerts that indicate meaningful user impact. The work connects indicators, target levels and response ownership so teams can make explicit reliability trade-offs.
offerings.scope: Define service indicators and objectives; tune thresholds; assign response routes.
offerings.deliverables: Reliability objectives; alert configuration; response ownership; review process.
offerings.value: Makes service expectations and operational action clearer.

offerings.name: Operational Readiness Assessment
offerings.definition: A readiness assessment of whether a service can be responsibly launched or operated. It checks ownership, monitoring, capacity, recovery and support arrangements, then identifies gaps requiring action before acceptance.
offerings.scope: Review operating responsibilities, runbooks, release controls and recovery evidence.
offerings.deliverables: Readiness checklist; gap register; action owners; acceptance recommendations.
offerings.value: Reduces avoidable surprises after launch or handover.

offerings.name: Monitoring & Observability
offerings.definition: Implementation of telemetry and views that help teams detect service problems and investigate their causes. Monitoring tracks known conditions; observability supports deeper investigation using logs, metrics and traces from agreed services.
offerings.scope: Instrument services; collect telemetry; build dashboards; configure alerts.
offerings.deliverables: Telemetry configuration; dashboards; alert routing; troubleshooting guidance.
offerings.value: Improves visibility into user impact and technical behavior.

offerings.name: Incident Investigation & Root Cause Analysis
offerings.definition: Structured investigation of a service incident to establish what happened, contributing factors and corrective actions. It distinguishes evidence from hypotheses and assigns follow-up work rather than attributing every failure to one simplistic cause.
offerings.scope: Reconstruct timeline; analyze evidence; identify contributing conditions; define actions.
offerings.deliverables: Incident review; causal findings; corrective backlog; updated response guidance.
offerings.value: Reduces recurrence and improves organizational learning.

offerings.name: Cloud Cost & Operations Health Check
offerings.definition: A combined review of cloud spending and operational ownership. It establishes an understandable baseline and identifies priority cost and operating improvements before recommending specific optimization work.
offerings.scope: Review bills, resource inventory, utilization and operating responsibilities.
offerings.deliverables: Cost baseline; ownership map; optimization priorities; operational findings.
offerings.value: Connects technology spending to accountable operating decisions.

offerings.name: Cloud Cost Review & Savings Roadmap
offerings.definition: Analysis of cloud consumption and spending to identify waste and practical optimization opportunities. Recommendations consider workload needs and implementation effort, with expected savings treated as estimates requiring validation.
offerings.scope: Analyze cost allocation, utilization and consumption; rank savings opportunities.
offerings.deliverables: Cost analysis; prioritized savings roadmap; assumptions and implementation owners.
offerings.value: Supports better-informed cloud cost decisions.

offerings.name: Resource Rightsizing & Capacity Optimization
offerings.definition: Adjustment of compute, storage or service capacity based on measured demand and performance requirements. Changes are validated to avoid reducing resource cost at the expense of essential service quality.
offerings.scope: Analyze utilization; model capacity needs; change resources; validate performance.
offerings.deliverables: Rightsizing recommendations; implemented adjustments; performance evidence; rollback plan.
offerings.value: Improves resource efficiency while preserving agreed service needs.

offerings.name: Cloud Cost Visibility & Budget Controls
offerings.definition: Implementation of cost allocation, reporting and budget-alert controls for cloud resources. It makes spending visible to accountable owners and supports investigation of unexpected usage without assuming alerts automatically stop expenditure.
offerings.scope: Configure ownership tags, allocation rules, cost views and budget notifications.
offerings.deliverables: Cost dashboards; budget alerts; allocation rules; ownership procedures.
offerings.value: Improves accountability and early detection of unexpected spending.

offerings.name: Platform Patching & Maintenance
offerings.definition: Planned upkeep of platform components through patching and routine maintenance. Compatibility review, change records and recovery preparation help keep the environment supportable within agreed service windows.
offerings.scope: Review updates; test compatibility; schedule maintenance; validate and document.
offerings.deliverables: Maintenance schedule; patched components; change records; rollback guidance.
offerings.value: Reduces accumulated maintenance risk and unplanned disruption.

offerings.name: Routine Operations Automation
offerings.definition: Automation of a defined repetitive operational task with appropriate validation, access and failure handling. The objective is a maintainable workflow that operators can understand, supervise and recover when assumptions fail.
offerings.scope: Map task; implement automation; test exceptions; document ownership.
offerings.deliverables: Automation scripts or workflow; tests; runbook; handover.
offerings.value: Reduces repetitive effort and inconsistent manual execution.

name: AI for Business & Software

offerings.name: AI Value Sprint
offerings.definition: A fixed-scope discovery engagement that evaluates one proposed AI use case or a stalled pilot. It compares business value, data readiness, feasibility and risk to recommend a practical next step with explicit success criteria.
offerings.scope: Baseline workflow; assess data; test key assumptions; define pilot boundary.
offerings.deliverables: Use-case assessment; feasibility findings; success measures; recommended next scope.
offerings.value: Avoids investing in AI without a clear business case.

offerings.name: AI Opportunity Assessment
offerings.definition: Assessment of candidate AI use cases against business value, feasibility, data availability and operating risk. It prioritizes opportunities where AI is appropriate rather than assuming every automation problem requires a model.
offerings.scope: Identify workflows; assess value and constraints; compare AI and non-AI options.
offerings.deliverables: Ranked opportunity portfolio; assumptions; recommended pilot candidates.
offerings.value: Directs investment toward relevant and feasible applications.

offerings.name: Data & Access Readiness Review
offerings.definition: A review of whether the data and access arrangements needed for an AI application are available and usable. It examines quality, permissions, ownership and integration constraints before model or workflow implementation.
offerings.scope: Review data sources, quality, access, ownership and permitted use.
offerings.deliverables: Readiness assessment; access requirements; remediation backlog.
offerings.value: Identifies data constraints before they undermine the AI project.

offerings.name: AI Application Health Check
offerings.definition: A diagnostic review of an existing AI application's quality, reliability and operating behavior. It investigates observed failures across prompts, retrieval, model use and integrations to recommend bounded corrective work.
offerings.scope: Review outputs, evaluations, architecture, usage and failure examples.
offerings.deliverables: Failure analysis; quality baseline; prioritized improvement plan.
offerings.value: Clarifies why a pilot or production AI workflow underperforms.

offerings.name: AI Platform Selection & Team Enablement
offerings.definition: Selection and initial enablement of AI tools or platforms suited to the team's use cases and constraints. It evaluates deployment, data handling, integration and operating needs, then prepares users to apply the chosen approach responsibly.
offerings.scope: Compare options; assess build versus buy; configure initial access; train team.
offerings.deliverables: Selection rationale; setup guidance; usage practices; enablement materials.
offerings.value: Improves fit between AI technology and everyday team needs.

offerings.name: AI Feature Launch Package
offerings.definition: A bounded engagement that brings an AI feature into an existing product journey. It includes application integration, evaluation and operational controls so the feature can be released with defined permissions, limits and fallback behavior.
offerings.scope: Design task; integrate model and context; evaluate outputs; add release controls.
offerings.deliverables: Working feature; evaluation results; permissions and limits; release handover.
offerings.value: Turns an AI concept into a usable, testable product capability.

offerings.name: In-app AI Assistants
offerings.definition: An AI-assisted interface embedded within an application to help users understand features, find information or complete defined tasks. Its context and available actions are limited by the application's permissions and designed responsibilities.
offerings.scope: Define assistance tasks; connect context; implement interface; evaluate answers.
offerings.deliverables: Embedded assistant; context integration; evaluation set; fallback behavior.
offerings.value: Reduces friction when users need guidance inside the product.

offerings.name: AI Summaries & Draft Generation
offerings.definition: Generation of summaries or first drafts for a specific user task using agreed source material and output formats. The workflow defines required review and checks for unsupported claims, omissions and inappropriate content.
offerings.scope: Define inputs and templates; configure generation; evaluate quality; add review.
offerings.deliverables: Generation workflow; output templates; evaluation results; review guidance.
offerings.value: Reduces drafting effort while preserving human accountability for final content.

offerings.name: Conversational Access to Product Data & Actions
offerings.definition: A conversational interface that translates user requests into controlled access to product data or functions. It connects language understanding to explicit application permissions, validation and confirmation rules for consequential actions.
offerings.scope: Map intents; expose approved functions; enforce access; test queries and actions.
offerings.deliverables: Conversational workflow; function integrations; permission tests; audit behavior.
offerings.value: Makes approved application capabilities easier to access.

offerings.name: Multi-tenant AI APIs
offerings.definition: Shared AI service interfaces designed for multiple customer organizations with separate permissions and usage controls. The service addresses tenant context, quotas, metering and fallback so a shared model integration does not imply shared customer access.
offerings.scope: Implement tenant-aware APIs; apply quotas and metering; validate isolation.
offerings.deliverables: AI API contracts; isolation tests; usage records; operating controls.
offerings.value: Supports controlled AI delivery across multiple customers.

offerings.name: Support Knowledge Assistant
offerings.definition: A starting knowledge-assistance solution that searches approved support content and drafts answers with references. It follows agreed access boundaries and provides uncertainty or escalation behavior when the available evidence is insufficient.
offerings.scope: Connect support sources; configure retrieval; generate referenced answers; evaluate.
offerings.deliverables: Working assistant; source connections; answer evaluations; escalation guidance.
offerings.value: Helps teams find relevant support information more quickly.

offerings.name: Knowledge Source Integration & Refresh
offerings.definition: Connection and ongoing refresh of content sources used by AI search or knowledge applications. It manages ingestion, updates and deletions so the available knowledge reflects the approved source systems and freshness requirements.
offerings.scope: Build connectors; transform content; schedule refresh; handle deletion and failures.
offerings.deliverables: Source pipelines; refresh schedule; ingestion monitoring; maintenance guide.
offerings.value: Reduces stale or missing information in knowledge workflows.

offerings.name: Intelligent Enterprise Search
offerings.definition: Search that retrieves relevant enterprise information using semantic or combined keyword and semantic techniques. It improves retrieval for agreed tasks while preserving source permissions and measuring relevance against representative queries.
offerings.scope: Prepare indexes; configure retrieval and ranking; test relevance and access.
offerings.deliverables: Search experience; index configuration; relevance evaluation; operating guide.
offerings.value: Reduces time spent locating business information.

offerings.name: Knowledge Assistants with Source References
offerings.definition: An AI answer service that uses retrieved enterprise content and exposes references supporting its response. It distinguishes grounded information from uncertainty and is evaluated for both retrieval quality and answer faithfulness.
offerings.scope: Configure retrieval and generation; attach references; test unsupported-answer handling.
offerings.deliverables: Knowledge assistant; reference behavior; evaluation results; content guidance.
offerings.value: Makes generated answers easier to verify against their sources.

offerings.name: Permission-based Knowledge Access
offerings.definition: Access enforcement for enterprise knowledge retrieval and generated answers. The service carries user, role or tenant permissions into content selection so restricted information is excluded before it can influence an answer.
offerings.scope: Map source permissions; filter retrieval; validate identity context; test leakage cases.
offerings.deliverables: Permission mapping; access controls; isolation tests; audit records.
offerings.value: Protects restricted information in shared knowledge tools.

offerings.name: Document Workflow Automation
offerings.definition: A bounded automation workflow that receives documents, extracts agreed information and checks it before updating another system. Exceptions are routed to people rather than allowing uncertain extraction to become an unchecked business transaction.
offerings.scope: Define intake and schemas; extract data; validate; route exceptions; integrate.
offerings.deliverables: Document pipeline; validation rules; reviewer queue; integration tests.
offerings.value: Reduces manual document handling while retaining exception control.

offerings.name: Document Classification & Routing
offerings.definition: Automated identification of document types and routing to the appropriate business process or team. The workflow defines supported categories, confidence handling and the treatment of unfamiliar or ambiguous documents.
offerings.scope: Define taxonomy; configure classifier; test samples; implement routing and exceptions.
offerings.deliverables: Classification workflow; category definitions; evaluation results; exception routing.
offerings.value: Reduces manual sorting and misdirected document work.

offerings.name: Document Data Extraction
offerings.definition: Conversion of information in documents into structured fields or tables aligned with an agreed schema. Validation and confidence handling address differences in layout, scan quality and document content.
offerings.scope: Define fields; configure extraction; test representative layouts; manage exceptions.
offerings.deliverables: Extraction pipeline; data schema; field-quality evaluation; review rules.
offerings.value: Reduces repetitive transcription of document information.

offerings.name: Document Validation & Cross-checks
offerings.definition: Verification of extracted document information against business rules, reference data or related documents. It identifies missing, inconsistent or suspicious values and routes discrepancies for resolution rather than silently correcting them.
offerings.scope: Define checks; compare fields and totals; match references; route discrepancies.
offerings.deliverables: Validation rules; discrepancy reports; review workflow; test evidence.
offerings.value: Prevents unreliable extracted data from entering downstream processes.

offerings.name: Document Review & System Integration
offerings.definition: A workflow through which people review document-processing exceptions and approve validated information for downstream systems. It connects review decisions to reliable updates and traceable processing status.
offerings.scope: Build reviewer queues; support corrections; integrate target systems; handle retries.
offerings.deliverables: Review interface; integration workflow; audit trail; exception runbook.
offerings.value: Keeps automated processing usable when human judgment is needed.

offerings.name: Service Request Automation
offerings.definition: A bounded workflow that interprets incoming service requests, gathers relevant context and prepares or performs permitted next steps. Explicit approval and exception rules govern updates to business systems.
offerings.scope: Define request types; gather context; draft responses; execute authorized updates.
offerings.deliverables: Request workflow; integrations; approval rules; evaluation and audit evidence.
offerings.value: Reduces repetitive request handling and improves routing consistency.

offerings.name: Request Understanding & Routing
offerings.definition: Interpretation of incoming messages to identify the requested service, relevant details and appropriate destination. The system handles ambiguity and unsupported requests through defined fallback routes.
offerings.scope: Define intents and required fields; configure classification; test routing.
offerings.deliverables: Intent model or rules; routing workflow; evaluation set; fallback process.
offerings.value: Reduces manual triage and avoidable reassignment.

offerings.name: AI-assisted Responses & Next Steps
offerings.definition: AI-generated response drafts or recommended next actions for a human reviewer handling a defined workflow. Suggestions use agreed context and remain subject to review before they become external communication or system changes.
offerings.scope: Connect context; define response patterns; generate suggestions; evaluate and review.
offerings.deliverables: Drafting workflow; recommendation templates; quality tests; reviewer guidance.
offerings.value: Helps staff respond consistently with less preparation effort.

offerings.name: CRM, ERP & Helpdesk Integration
offerings.definition: Integration that enables an AI workflow to read or update agreed customer, enterprise or service-management records. Business permissions, record ownership and transaction controls remain authoritative across the connection.
offerings.scope: Map records and actions; connect APIs; enforce access; handle duplicates and failures.
offerings.deliverables: System connectors; action contracts; permission tests; transaction logs.
offerings.value: Connects AI assistance to practical business work.

offerings.name: Task Agents with Approval Controls
offerings.definition: Implementation of an AI agent for a limited task with explicit tool permissions and human approval points. The agent operates within a defined action boundary and records what it proposed, attempted and completed.
offerings.scope: Define tools and limits; implement approvals; test failures and unauthorized requests.
offerings.deliverables: Bounded agent; approval workflow; action logs; exception and recovery behavior.
offerings.value: Automates selected tasks while preserving decision control.

offerings.name: Engineering AI Starter Package
offerings.definition: A starting engagement that configures AI assistance for one engineering workflow and establishes reviewed usage practices. Repository context, quality checks and team handover make the approach repeatable beyond an isolated demonstration.
offerings.scope: Select workflow; configure tools and context; evaluate results; train team.
offerings.deliverables: Configured workflow; repository guidance; evaluation evidence; adoption materials.
offerings.value: Creates a practical baseline for team-wide engineering assistance.

offerings.name: AI-assisted Development Pilot
offerings.definition: A limited delivery experiment in which engineers use AI assistance to complete an agreed software increment. Human review and existing quality controls remain in place while the team evaluates whether the approach is useful and repeatable.
offerings.scope: Choose increment; establish workflow; deliver reviewed changes; assess results.
offerings.deliverables: Software increment; review and test evidence; pilot findings; repeatable guidance.
offerings.value: Tests AI assistance against actual delivery work.

offerings.name: AI-assisted Software Development
offerings.definition: Software development in which AI tools support selected tasks such as drafting code, explaining changes or proposing tests. Engineers remain responsible for design, verification and acceptance of the resulting software.
offerings.scope: Implement agreed changes with AI support; review code; test and document.
offerings.deliverables: Reviewed code; test evidence; release notes; workflow guidance.
offerings.value: Can reduce routine effort while retaining engineering accountability.

offerings.name: AI-assisted DevOps Enablement
offerings.definition: Enablement of AI assistance for defined infrastructure or delivery tasks, such as proposing configuration changes and explaining automation. Proposed changes are reviewed and tested before they affect environments.
offerings.scope: Configure repository context; generate proposed changes; validate and review automation.
offerings.deliverables: Reviewed automation; assistant guidance; tests; controlled operating workflow.
offerings.value: Helps teams work through repetitive or unfamiliar DevOps tasks.

offerings.name: AI Coding Tools & Team Onboarding
offerings.definition: Configuration and adoption support for AI coding tools within an engineering team. It covers approved usage, repository access and review practices so team members understand both productive uses and practical limits.
offerings.scope: Set up access; configure tools; define usage rules; run onboarding sessions.
offerings.deliverables: Tool configuration; team guide; training materials; adoption checklist.
offerings.value: Reduces inconsistent adoption and avoidable misuse of coding assistants.

offerings.name: Codebase Navigation & Understanding
offerings.definition: AI-assisted exploration of a codebase to help engineers locate relevant components and understand behavior. Explanations are grounded in repository material and checked against source code rather than treated as authoritative by default.
offerings.scope: Index approved repositories; configure navigation; test representative engineering questions.
offerings.deliverables: Code navigation workflow; repository context; validation examples; onboarding guide.
offerings.value: Reduces time spent orienting engineers in unfamiliar code.

offerings.name: AI-assisted Code Review & Testing
offerings.definition: AI assistance that proposes code-review observations or test cases for engineers to evaluate. It complements established review and test processes, with validation of suggested defects, coverage and generated test behavior.
offerings.scope: Define review tasks; configure context; generate suggestions; measure usefulness.
offerings.deliverables: Review assistance; proposed tests; quality evaluation; reviewer guidance.
offerings.value: Helps reviewers identify additional issues and reduce repetitive preparation.

offerings.name: AI-assisted Pipeline Troubleshooting
offerings.definition: AI-assisted analysis of delivery-pipeline failures using available logs, configuration and recent changes. It proposes explanations or corrections for engineering review without assuming that a plausible explanation establishes the root cause.
offerings.scope: Connect pipeline context; summarize failures; propose fixes; validate suggestions.
offerings.deliverables: Troubleshooting workflow; diagnostic summaries; reviewed correction proposals.
offerings.value: Reduces the effort needed to understand recurring pipeline failures.

offerings.name: Intelligent Alert Triage
offerings.definition: Assistance that groups related alerts and adds service context to help operators prioritize investigation. It is evaluated against real alert examples so noise reduction does not conceal distinct or high-impact incidents.
offerings.scope: Correlate alerts; enrich context; rank cases; validate operator decisions.
offerings.deliverables: Triage workflow; incident context views; evaluation results; escalation rules.
offerings.value: Helps operators focus attention on meaningful incident signals.

offerings.name: AI-assisted Incident Investigation
offerings.definition: AI-assisted organization of incident evidence into summaries and likely-cause hypotheses. The service supports investigators in examining logs, changes and dependencies while making the distinction between observed facts and suggestions explicit.
offerings.scope: Connect incident evidence; generate timelines and hypotheses; support validation.
offerings.deliverables: Investigation assistant; evidence summaries; hypothesis records; review process.
offerings.value: Speeds orientation during incident investigation.

offerings.name: Guided Recovery with Approval Controls
offerings.definition: A guided operational workflow that retrieves relevant recovery procedures and coordinates permitted actions. Approval gates, validation and rollback boundaries control when a recommendation may become a real environment change.
offerings.scope: Connect runbooks; define action permissions; implement approvals; test recovery steps.
offerings.deliverables: Guided workflow; approval records; execution logs; recovery validation.
offerings.value: Reduces recovery coordination effort while preserving operator control.

offerings.name: Incident Summaries & Follow-up Actions
offerings.definition: Generation of structured incident summaries and proposed follow-up actions from approved incident records. A reviewer verifies the timeline, impact and ownership before the record is used for communication or improvement tracking.
offerings.scope: Gather incident records; draft summary; propose actions; review and publish internally.
offerings.deliverables: Reviewed incident report; action list; ownership suggestions; source references.
offerings.value: Reduces post-incident documentation effort.

offerings.name: AI Reliability & Operations
offerings.definition: A diagnostic and operating service for accepted AI workflows that monitors quality, source changes, failures and usage. Improvements are scoped against a defined baseline rather than assuming a model remains reliable after deployment.
offerings.scope: Establish baseline; monitor quality and cost; investigate failures; implement agreed improvements.
offerings.deliverables: AI operating plan; evaluations; monitoring reports; improvement backlog.
offerings.value: Supports continued usefulness as data, models and usage change.

offerings.name: AI Quality Evaluation & Regression Testing
offerings.definition: A repeatable evaluation process that measures AI behavior on representative examples and detects regressions after changes. It defines relevant quality criteria and tests failure cases instead of relying only on demonstrations or average scores.
offerings.scope: Build test datasets; define scoring; run comparisons; investigate regressions.
offerings.deliverables: Evaluation dataset; scoring rubric; regression reports; release recommendations.
offerings.value: Makes AI quality decisions more evidence-based.

offerings.name: AI Permissions, Approvals & Audit Controls
offerings.definition: Implementation of access boundaries, decision approvals and traceable records for AI-supported workflows. Controls govern the surrounding application and tools rather than relying on instructions to the model as the only protection.
offerings.scope: Enforce permissions; define approval steps; log actions; test bypass scenarios.
offerings.deliverables: Access controls; approval workflow; audit records; boundary-test results.
offerings.value: Preserves accountability when AI participates in business processes.

offerings.name: AI Deployment & Cost Controls
offerings.definition: Deployment and operating controls for AI services that manage release changes, usage and expenditure. The service defines monitoring, limits and fallback or rollback behavior for the selected model and application arrangement.
offerings.scope: Configure releases; monitor usage; set limits; validate rollback and fallback.
offerings.deliverables: Deployment workflow; usage controls; monitoring views; recovery guide.
offerings.value: Improves control over AI operating cost and release risk.

offerings.name: Continuous AI Improvement & Maintenance
offerings.definition: Ongoing, scoped maintenance of an AI workflow based on evaluation results and operating feedback. It addresses changes to content, prompts, integrations or model configuration while preserving evidence of whether quality improved or regressed.
offerings.scope: Review evaluations; prioritize changes; maintain sources and integrations; retest.
offerings.deliverables: Maintained workflow; change records; evaluation comparisons; improvement backlog.
offerings.value: Keeps the workflow aligned with evolving business information and needs.
