name: Cybersecurity

offerings.name: Threat Modeling & Attack Path Review
offerings.definition: A structured examination of how important assets could be misused or compromised through their architecture and dependencies. It identifies plausible attack paths and prioritizes preventive controls based on business impact and feasibility.
offerings.scope: Map assets and trust boundaries; model threats; assess attack paths; rank treatments.
offerings.deliverables: Threat model; attack-path findings; prioritized control recommendations.
offerings.value: Helps teams address important design risks before incidents occur.

offerings.name: Cyber Threat Intelligence
offerings.definition: Collection and analysis of relevant threat information to support security decisions. It connects external indicators, exposure reports and adversary activity to the organization's actual assets and priorities rather than forwarding unfiltered threat feeds.
offerings.scope: Define intelligence needs; monitor relevant sources; validate findings; brief stakeholders.
offerings.deliverables: Threat briefs; contextual indicators; exposure findings; recommended actions.
offerings.value: Improves prioritization of security attention.

offerings.name: Red Team & Purple Team Exercises
offerings.definition: An authorized adversary simulation that tests whether selected security defenses and response processes work in practice. Red-team activity pursues agreed objectives; purple-team collaboration helps defenders examine and improve detection during or after testing.
offerings.scope: Agree rules and objectives; simulate attacks; review detection and response; retest improvements.
offerings.deliverables: Exercise plan; evidence; detection gaps; improvement recommendations.
offerings.value: Tests operational defenses against realistic attack behavior.

offerings.name: Penetration Testing
offerings.definition: An authorized, scoped attempt to identify and validate exploitable weaknesses in selected applications or infrastructure. It produces evidence-based findings and remediation guidance within agreed rules, with retesting defined separately or explicitly included.
offerings.scope: Define targets and rules; test weaknesses; validate impact; report and retest as agreed.
offerings.deliverables: Technical findings; risk priorities; remediation guidance; agreed retest results.
offerings.value: Identifies exploitable weaknesses before an attacker can use them.

offerings.name: AI & Generative AI Security
offerings.definition: A bounded review of AI and generative-AI systems that combines system inventory, data-access review and adversarial testing. It examines prompt-based attacks, information leakage and action boundaries, then recommends practical controls and usage rules.
offerings.scope: Inventory AI workflows; review data access; test misuse; define guardrails.
offerings.deliverables: AI exposure inventory; security findings; control plan; usage guidance.
offerings.value: Clarifies risks introduced by business adoption of generative AI.

offerings.name: Network & Endpoint Security
offerings.definition: Design and implementation of safeguards for endpoints and network communication. The service coordinates device protection, network segmentation and monitoring around the actual operating environment rather than treating each control as a standalone installation.
offerings.scope: Assess devices and traffic; configure protection and segmentation; validate detection.
offerings.deliverables: Security configurations; segmentation rules; test results; operating procedures.
offerings.value: Reduces opportunities for compromise and uncontrolled lateral movement.

offerings.name: Cloud Native Security
offerings.definition: Security assessment and implementation for cloud accounts, services, containers and orchestration environments. It addresses cloud-specific configuration and access risks while clarifying the responsibilities retained by the organization and those of its providers.
offerings.scope: Review cloud posture; harden configurations; manage workload access; enable monitoring.
offerings.deliverables: Posture findings; implemented controls; access rules; monitoring guidance.
offerings.value: Reduces cloud misconfiguration and unnecessary exposure.

offerings.name: Data Protection
offerings.definition: A coordinated approach to identifying sensitive data and protecting it throughout storage, use and transfer. It aligns classification, access restrictions, loss-prevention controls and encryption with the organization's data handling requirements.
offerings.scope: Classify data; map flows; configure protection; manage exceptions and validation.
offerings.deliverables: Data-handling rules; protection configurations; findings; operating procedures.
offerings.value: Reduces unintended exposure of important business information.

offerings.name: AI Security
offerings.definition: Security assessment and improvement of selected AI models, copilots and their supporting workflows. It examines how inputs, retrieved data and tool permissions could produce unauthorized disclosure or behavior, within a defined technical scope.
offerings.scope: Review AI architecture; test prompt attacks and leakage; improve access boundaries.
offerings.deliverables: AI security findings; prioritized mitigations; validation tests; control guidance.
offerings.value: Helps teams secure a specific AI implementation.

offerings.name: OT / ICS Security
offerings.definition: Security work for operational technology and industrial control systems where availability and physical process safety constrain changes. The service prioritizes asset visibility, separation and controlled access while coordinating testing and remediation with operational owners.
offerings.scope: Inventory assets; assess communication paths; review access; plan safe improvements.
offerings.deliverables: Asset view; segmentation recommendations; access controls; staged remediation plan.
offerings.value: Improves industrial security without ignoring operating constraints.

offerings.name: Identity & Privileged Access Management
offerings.definition: Management of workforce, privileged and machine access across agreed systems. It combines identity lifecycle control with restrictions and oversight for high-privilege activity so access can be justified, reviewed and removed when no longer needed.
offerings.scope: Inventory identities; define least privilege; configure privileged access; review lifecycle.
offerings.deliverables: Access model; privileged-access controls; review process; audit evidence.
offerings.value: Reduces excessive and unmanaged access to critical systems.

offerings.name: Zero Trust Architecture
offerings.definition: An architecture approach in which access decisions depend on verified identities, resource context and policy rather than implicit trust in network location. The engagement defines a practical transition design across selected users, devices and applications.
offerings.scope: Assess access paths; define policy enforcement; design segmentation and identity controls.
offerings.deliverables: Reference architecture; access patterns; phased roadmap; validation criteria.
offerings.value: Limits unnecessary trust and improves consistency of access decisions.

offerings.name: Executive Security Advisory
offerings.definition: A security-leadership engagement that combines fractional executive guidance with board-level risk communication. It translates technical concerns into priorities, ownership and investment decisions while maintaining oversight of the security program and relevant vendors.
offerings.scope: Review posture; set roadmap; advise leadership; prepare board reporting.
offerings.deliverables: Security roadmap; board materials; decision recommendations; oversight cadence.
offerings.value: Connects security investment to executive business decisions.

offerings.name: vCISO Retainer Services
offerings.definition: Provision of part-time security leadership to guide an organization's security program without a full-time executive appointment. Responsibilities and authority are agreed across priorities, policies, risk treatment and coordination with internal teams.
offerings.scope: Establish priorities; guide program work; coordinate stakeholders; report progress.
offerings.deliverables: Security plan; governance cadence; risk updates; leadership advice.
offerings.value: Provides accountable security direction at an agreed engagement level.

offerings.name: Security Governance
offerings.definition: Definition of the policies, responsibilities and decision processes through which an organization manages security. Governance clarifies who sets requirements, accepts risk and verifies performance, rather than treating security as a collection of tools.
offerings.scope: Define policies, decision rights, control ownership and oversight routines.
offerings.deliverables: Governance framework; policy set; responsibility matrix; review calendar.
offerings.value: Makes security decisions and ownership consistent.

offerings.name: Cyber Risk Management
offerings.definition: A process for identifying, assessing and treating cyber risks in business terms. It connects threats and weaknesses to consequences, accountable owners and treatment decisions while making assessment assumptions explicit.
offerings.scope: Identify scenarios; assess likelihood and impact; assign owners; plan treatment.
offerings.deliverables: Risk register; assessment rationale; treatment plan; reporting approach.
offerings.value: Helps leaders prioritize risk-reduction investment.

offerings.name: Compliance & Audit Readiness
offerings.definition: An engagement that organizes applicable control requirements and supporting evidence into a coordinated audit-readiness program. It includes gap analysis and remediation planning, while formal certification or audit conclusions remain with the relevant independent assessor.
offerings.scope: Map requirements; test readiness; organize evidence; plan corrective actions.
offerings.deliverables: Control mapping; evidence index; gap assessment; remediation plan.
offerings.value: Reduces fragmented preparation for multiple assurance requirements.

offerings.name: Compliance Program Management
offerings.definition: Implementation and maintenance of a structured program for meeting selected compliance requirements. It assigns control responsibilities, evidence routines and review activities so compliance work becomes repeatable rather than a one-time document exercise.
offerings.scope: Define applicable controls; assign owners; establish evidence collection and review.
offerings.deliverables: Compliance plan; control ownership; evidence schedule; reporting process.
offerings.value: Makes recurring compliance obligations easier to manage.

offerings.name: Audit Readiness & Assurance
offerings.definition: A focused readiness review of control design, operation and supporting evidence before an audit or assurance activity. It identifies gaps and corrective actions without representing the readiness reviewer as the final certifying authority.
offerings.scope: Review evidence; test selected controls; identify gaps; track remediation.
offerings.deliverables: Readiness report; evidence findings; remediation tracker; audit preparation guidance.
offerings.value: Improves the quality and completeness of audit preparation.

offerings.name: Vulnerability Management
offerings.definition: An ongoing process for discovering, prioritizing and addressing technical vulnerabilities across defined assets. It combines scanning with asset context, ownership and verification so the process measures closure rather than merely accumulating findings.
offerings.scope: Define coverage; scan; validate and prioritize; assign remediation; verify closure.
offerings.deliverables: Vulnerability inventory; prioritized work queue; remediation reports; retest evidence.
offerings.value: Focuses remediation on relevant and consequential weaknesses.

offerings.name: Application Security & Secure Development
offerings.definition: Integration of security activities into application design, development and release. It combines requirements, review and suitable testing to help engineering teams prevent and detect weaknesses as part of their normal delivery process.
offerings.scope: Define security requirements; review designs; integrate code and runtime checks; manage findings.
offerings.deliverables: Secure-development practices; test configurations; remediation backlog; developer guidance.
offerings.value: Reduces avoidable application weaknesses throughout delivery.

offerings.name: Attack Surface & Exposure Management
offerings.definition: Discovery and assessment of exposed assets and reachable weaknesses from an attacker-oriented perspective. It connects asset visibility, exposure validation and business importance rather than relying only on a vulnerability identifier list.
offerings.scope: Discover internet-facing assets; verify ownership; assess exposure; prioritize paths.
offerings.deliverables: Attack-surface inventory; validated exposures; prioritized treatment recommendations.
offerings.value: Makes overlooked external exposure visible and actionable.

offerings.name: Remediation Management
offerings.definition: Coordination of security fixes from finding through verified closure. It establishes accountable owners, due dates, exceptions and retesting so remediation progresses across teams and unresolved risk remains visible.
offerings.scope: Assign findings; track work; manage exceptions; coordinate retests.
offerings.deliverables: Remediation tracker; ownership and deadlines; exception records; closure evidence.
offerings.value: Reduces stalled findings and unclear responsibility.

offerings.name: Incident & Ransomware Readiness
offerings.definition: A preparedness engagement that brings together incident procedures and ransomware recovery considerations before a crisis. It uses exercises to test decisions, communications, isolation and restoration assumptions under realistic disruption scenarios.
offerings.scope: Review playbooks and backups; define decisions; run tabletop; prioritize gaps.
offerings.deliverables: Readiness assessment; response and recovery plans; exercise findings; action list.
offerings.value: Helps leadership and operators rehearse coordinated response.

offerings.name: SOC & Security Monitoring
offerings.definition: Operation or enablement of a security monitoring function that collects relevant signals and coordinates investigation and escalation. Coverage, staffing hours and response responsibilities must be agreed explicitly rather than inferred from the term SOC.
offerings.scope: Integrate telemetry; configure detection; triage alerts; escalate and report.
offerings.deliverables: Monitoring configuration; detection rules; incident queue; service reporting.
offerings.value: Improves visibility and coordination for suspected security incidents.

offerings.name: Security Incident Response
offerings.definition: Preparation and execution support for handling security incidents through defined roles, analysis, containment and communication. The scope clarifies whether the engagement provides readiness planning, retained assistance or active incident support.
offerings.scope: Define playbooks; investigate evidence; coordinate containment; support communications.
offerings.deliverables: Response plan or incident record; containment actions; recovery recommendations; lessons learned.
offerings.value: Reduces confusion and delay during security incidents.

offerings.name: Digital Forensics & Incident Investigation
offerings.definition: Specialist collection and examination of digital evidence to reconstruct events and support an investigation. Evidence handling, integrity and documentation are planned explicitly, with the investigation boundary and intended use agreed in advance.
offerings.scope: Preserve evidence; collect artifacts; analyze activity; document timeline and findings.
offerings.deliverables: Evidence inventory; analysis report; event timeline; documented handling record.
offerings.value: Provides a defensible technical account of observed events.

offerings.name: Ransomware Readiness
offerings.definition: Assessment and rehearsal of the organization's ability to withstand and recover from ransomware disruption. It examines backup integrity, isolation options and decision-making so recovery assumptions are tested before an extortion scenario occurs.
offerings.scope: Review backups; assess isolation; define decisions; rehearse recovery scenario.
offerings.deliverables: Readiness findings; decision playbook; backup-test evidence; improvement plan.
offerings.value: Improves preparation for destructive or extortion-driven disruption.

offerings.name: Business Continuity Planning (BCP)
offerings.definition: Planning for continuity of critical business processes during disruption to systems, sites, people or suppliers. It defines operational alternatives and priorities beyond technical restoration alone, then tests whether those arrangements are practical.
offerings.scope: Analyze business impact; define continuity strategies; assign roles; exercise plans.
offerings.deliverables: Business continuity plan; process priorities; exercise results; action backlog.
offerings.value: Helps essential business activities continue during disruption.

offerings.name: Recovery Planning & Disaster Recovery Testing
offerings.definition: Definition and testing of recovery arrangements for selected systems and data. It translates business recovery priorities into technical restoration procedures and measures whether agreed recovery objectives are achievable under the tested scenario.
offerings.scope: Set objectives; document dependencies; rehearse restoration; record gaps.
offerings.deliverables: Disaster recovery plan; measured recovery results; validation evidence; improvement actions.
offerings.value: Replaces assumed recoverability with tested evidence.

offerings.name: ERP Discovery & Blueprint

offerings.deliverables: ERP blueprint; requirements; fit-gap decisions; recommended roadmap.
offerings.value: Reduces ambiguity before committing to a major system implementation.

offerings.name: Business Process Discovery & Blueprint
offerings.definition: Detailed discovery of current business processes and design of the intended future workflow. It connects activities, roles, data and controls into a blueprint that business owners can validate before system configuration begins.
offerings.scope: Map current and future processes; define owners, requirements and exceptions.
offerings.deliverables: Process maps; requirements backlog; fit-gap register; approved blueprint.
offerings.value: Aligns the implementation around agreed business behavior.

offerings.name: ERP Platform Selection & Solution Design
offerings.definition: Selection of an ERP platform and design of a solution that fits the organization's operating requirements. The service compares functional fit and constraints, then defines modules, data, integrations and access for the chosen direction.
offerings.scope: Evaluate platforms; assess modules and licensing assumptions; design solution boundaries.
offerings.deliverables: Selection matrix; solution blueprint; integration and data approach; rollout recommendations.
offerings.value: Reduces mismatch between platform capabilities and business needs.

offerings.name: ERP Configuration & Implementation
offerings.definition: Configuration and implementation of an ERP system around agreed business workflows. It establishes modules, records, access and approvals, with testing and handover defined for the selected entities and operating scope.
offerings.scope: Configure modules and master data; define roles and workflows; test business scenarios.
offerings.deliverables: Configured ERP; setup documentation; test evidence; operating handover.
offerings.value: Provides a connected system for agreed operational and financial processes.

offerings.name: ERP Customization & Extensions

offerings.scope: Assess fit gap; design extension; implement scripts or components; test compatibility.
offerings.deliverables: Extension code; technical documentation; regression tests; maintenance guidance.
offerings.value: Supports necessary differentiation while making customization costs visible.

offerings.name: Workflow Testing & User Acceptance

offerings.scope: Define scenarios; prepare data; run tests; manage defects; obtain business acceptance.
offerings.deliverables: Test cases; execution results; defect log; user acceptance record.
offerings.value: Reduces operational surprises at go-live.

offerings.name: NetSuite Order-to-Cash

offerings.scope: Map transaction flow; configure agreed steps; integrate interfaces; test reconciliation.
offerings.deliverables: Configured workflow; transaction tests; exception procedures; user guidance.
offerings.value: Improves traceability from customer order to receivable settlement.

offerings.name: Odoo Sales, Inventory & Purchasing
offerings.definition: Configuration of selected Odoo applications to connect sales, stock and purchasing workflows. The service defines how quotations, deliveries, replenishment and supplier transactions interact within the chosen edition, modules and business scope.
offerings.scope: Map process; configure modules; define inventory and purchasing rules; test scenarios.
offerings.deliverables: Configured workflow; module setup; transaction tests; role-based guidance.
offerings.value: Improves coordination between customer demand and inventory supply.

offerings.name: ERPNext Manufacturing Flow
offerings.definition: Configuration of an ERPNext manufacturing workflow connecting materials, bills of materials, work orders and finished output. It aligns the selected production process with stock movements and the information needed by operations.
offerings.scope: Map production flow; configure items and bills; test material and work-order transactions.
offerings.deliverables: Manufacturing configuration; master-data structure; scenario tests; operator guidance.
offerings.value: Improves visibility of material requirements and production progress.

offerings.name: Reachware iPaaS Integration
offerings.definition: Implementation of agreed integration flows using Reachware as the integration platform. It connects selected business systems through explicit mappings, operational monitoring and exception handling, subject to available connectors and platform capabilities.
offerings.scope: Confirm connectors; map records; build flows; test errors and ownership.
offerings.deliverables: Integration flows; mapping specifications; monitoring setup; support runbook.
offerings.value: Reduces manual movement of information across connected systems.

offerings.name: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Customer Workflows
offerings.definition: Design and configuration of selected Dynamics 365 applications for agreed finance or customer workflows. Scope depends on the specific products and editions selected; the service does not assume every Dynamics application is included.
offerings.scope: Map processes; confirm apps and licensing; configure workflows; integrate and test.
offerings.deliverables: Solution design; configured workflows; integration tests; handover materials.
offerings.value: Connects financial or customer processes within a defined Microsoft solution.

offerings.name: ERP Data Migration & Cutover
offerings.definition: A bounded migration engagement that moves agreed ERP data and coordinates transition to the target system. It combines trial migrations, business reconciliation and cutover decisions so acceptance is based on verified records and balances.
offerings.scope: Define migration scope; prepare data; trial imports; reconcile; execute cutover.
offerings.deliverables: Migration scripts; reconciled data; business sign-off; cutover and rollback plan.
offerings.value: Reduces disruption and uncertainty during ERP transition.

offerings.name: ERP Data Migration & Reconciliation
offerings.definition: Preparation and transfer of ERP data with explicit checks that the target records reflect the approved source. It addresses cleansing, mapping and reconciliation rather than treating successful file import as proof of correctness.
offerings.scope: Profile and clean data; map fields; trial load; reconcile records and totals.
offerings.deliverables: Mapping rules; migration routines; reconciliation results; exception log.
offerings.value: Improves trust in the data used after implementation.

offerings.name: ERP Integration with CRM, Commerce, POS & Legacy Apps
offerings.definition: Integration of an ERP with customer, commerce, point-of-sale or legacy applications. The design defines authoritative records, transaction timing and recovery behavior so updates remain consistent across the business workflow.
offerings.scope: Specify interfaces; map data ownership; implement synchronization; test retries and duplicates.
offerings.deliverables: Integration components; interface specification; exception handling; operating guide.
offerings.value: Reduces duplicated entry and mismatched transaction states.

offerings.name: Salesforce CRM & CRM-to-ERP Handoff

offerings.scope: Map customer and order flow; configure CRM; integrate handoff and status updates.
offerings.deliverables: CRM configuration; ERP connector; mapping and tests; exception procedures.
offerings.value: Improves continuity between sales activity and operational execution.

offerings.name: Shopify & Commerce-to-ERP Integration
offerings.definition: Integration of Shopify commerce activity with the selected ERP or business systems. It defines product, order, stock, fulfillment and returns behavior so customer-facing information and back-office records can be reconciled.
offerings.scope: Map records; connect interfaces; handle inventory, returns and failures; reconcile.
offerings.deliverables: Commerce integration; mapping rules; reconciliation checks; support procedures.
offerings.value: Reduces manual order handling and inconsistent stock or fulfillment information.

offerings.name: ERP Health Check & Improvement
offerings.definition: A focused review of an existing ERP followed by a prioritized improvement to one important constraint. It combines diagnosis with bounded corrective work rather than assuming a complete reimplementation is necessary.
offerings.scope: Assess pain points; prioritize issue; implement agreed fix; validate workflow.
offerings.deliverables: Health findings; targeted improvement; test evidence; next-step recommendations.
offerings.value: Creates a practical improvement path for an underperforming ERP.

offerings.name: Training, Handover & Go-live Readiness
offerings.definition: Preparation of business users and operating teams to adopt and support a system at go-live. It combines role-based learning, practical guidance and explicit transition responsibilities so handover is operationally usable.
offerings.scope: Train roles; document procedures; prepare support handover; confirm cutover responsibilities.
offerings.deliverables: Training materials; user guides; handover records; readiness checklist.
offerings.value: Improves adoption and reduces avoidable disruption during transition.

offerings.scope: Handle issues; perform maintenance; manage escalations; prioritize agreed changes.
offerings.deliverables: Support scope; ticket reports; maintenance records; operating reviews.
offerings.value: Provides continuity and clear ownership after go-live.

offerings.name: ERP Review & Targeted Improvement
offerings.definition: A scoped assessment and correction of a specific ERP problem, such as a workflow, report, configuration gap or integration. It starts with the observed business issue and validates that the selected change addresses it.
offerings.scope: Diagnose issue; define improvement; configure or develop fix; test with users.
offerings.deliverables: Review findings; implemented correction; user validation; updated guidance.
offerings.value: Addresses a concrete operating problem without unnecessary transformation scope.

offerings.name: ERP Reporting & Operational Dashboards
offerings.definition: Design and implementation of ERP reports and dashboards using agreed source data and calculation rules. It clarifies definitions, access and refresh needs so finance and operations can interpret the same measure consistently.
offerings.scope: Define measures; validate sources; build reports; test reconciliation and access.
offerings.deliverables: Report specifications; dashboards; reconciliation evidence; user guidance.
offerings.value: Improves visibility of business performance using consistent definitions.
